2814.title: Startup reconciliation omits a marker for idle agent runs
2814.rootCauseOneLine: The idle-thread branch returns only a successful status, and the database writer stores an omitted reason as null.
2814.proposedFix: Store an interruption marker in skipReason when startup reconciliation infers success from an idle thread.
2814.caveats: The private historical dataset claim was not tested because it was unnecessary for direct reproduction.
